text_block_list.text:
I won the Takarazuka Kinen. Yet, the 
voices criticizing me for not acting like 
a princess have not ceased...

Splendid! After all, I am striving to 
become "the ideal princess I can be proud 
of"! It seems Vodka understood that 
completely!

Next up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
Some may say she isn't acting queenly, but 
that's not a problem at all!

I shall simply compete in my own way 
against fellow seekers of the ideal! 
Locked chest-to-chest with my 
Princess☆Arms!
